integrity: Exact rational finite census with standalone source; infinite family proved algebraically. The value-ordering principle and existence of non-distance-optimal bias strategies are acknowledged as earlier work; no independent proof certification claimed.
limitations: Discrete-time two iid uniform neighbor offers with replacement, expected time to one fixed target, connected simple undirected unweighted graphs. Does not cover finite deadlines, cover times, unique obstructions, weighted or directed graphs.
title: The seven-vertex onset of distance-first failure in two-offer random walks
